name: dropdown-menu
description: A source-owned compositional dropdown menu with roving-focus keyboard navigation.

documentation.compositionNote: The copied façade re-exports the owned DropdownMenu parts unstyled, matching select's approach: DropdownMenuItem is generic, so applications style each primitive part directly with Dioxus class attributes while the runtime retains roving-focus keyboard and ARIA behavior.
documentation.accessibility: `DropdownMenu`/`DropdownMenuTrigger`/`DropdownMenuContent`/`DropdownMenuItem` are direct re-exports of the shared `menu::Menu`/`MenuTrigger`/`MenuContent`/`MenuItem` primitive (`packages/adico-primitives/src/menu.rs`), matching Base UI's own anatomy where `Menu` *is* the dropdown menu -- `role="menu"`/`role="menuitem"` content on a roving-focus/dismissable-layer stack shared with `dialog`/`popover`.
documentation.keyboard: Arrow keys navigate items, Enter/Space activates the focused item, `ArrowRight`/`ArrowLeft` open/close submenus (`MenuSubmenuTrigger`); submenu hover-intent delay is not implemented, only click and arrow-key open/close.
